Fit tests pass295 JVM/286 JS, image305/284, dataset76/62 in isolated source candidate. Retained patch extraction excluded unrelated DCT/event-support work and adapted obsolete test image wrappers. Reconciled image4s18ffdce incremental/refinement prerequisite independently passes core96/92 and NIfTI55/37 JVM/JS. Exact sources/patches/logs retained in docs/verification/estimate-set-increment; no ephemeral-only prerequisite.

Default image4s pin lacks required new APIs; tests used explicit -Dscalafim.image4s.build=/tmp/estimate-image4s-provider. Do not adopt divergent published accea049 branch or restore old image aliases. Broader response-basis/consumer admission is not implied by these tests.
